title: patent-disclosure-skill turns Chinese patent work into an agent workflow
friendlyTitle: A popular AI skill helps organise Chinese patent work
summary: This actively maintained Chinese-language agent skill packages workflows for finding patentable ideas, preparing invention disclosures, explaining patents and assisting with examination responses. It has about 6,200 GitHub stars and includes prompts, references, examples, scripts and tests.
friendlySummary: This project gives AI agents a structured process for Chinese patent research, explanations, draft disclosures and examination replies.
whyItMatters: Chinese-speaking inventors and patent professionals can use it as a structured starting point for research and drafting, while keeping qualified legal review in the loop. Its repository layout is also a useful example of turning deep domain practice into a reusable agent skill.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help organise early research and drafts, but a qualified patent professional should still check important legal work.
